## Major Projects

### HappenGrid – Event Management Platform
- **Type:** Client Project (Freelance) / Live Web Platform
- **Tech Stack:** Django, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS Lightsail (VPS), Coolify, AWS S3, AWS SES, Razorpay, GitHub CI/CD
- **Description:** End-to-end event management platform where organizers can host and manage events while attendees explore, register, and follow communities.
- **Key Modules & Architecture:**
  - **Attendee Portal:** Event discovery, paid/free ticket booking, and community following.
  - **Organizer Dashboard:** Event creation & lifecycle management, ticket tracking, and event payout requests.
  - **Admin Dashboard:** Platform-wide oversight of organizers, events, blogs, user inquiries/reports, and organizer payout disbursements.
  - **Payments & Infrastructure:** Integrated Razorpay payment gateway; deployed on AWS Lightsail VPS managed via Coolify with automated GitHub push-to-deploy CI/CD; automated daily PostgreSQL backups & image storage on AWS S3; transactional emails & password resets via AWS SES.
- **Live Demo Link:** [https://happengrid.com](https://happengrid.com)

### House of Deepak – E-commerce Platform
- **Type:** Live Site (E-commerce) / Client Project
- **Tech Stack:** React 18, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Storage), Node.js, Express, Razorpay, React Query, React Hook Form
- **Description:** Comprehensive e-commerce platform for fashion brand House of Deepak featuring two distinct brand collections — traditional Indian wear and contemporary Western wear — delivering an elegant, mobile-first shopping experience with full cart, checkout, payment gateway, and admin capabilities.
- **Key Features & Modules:**
  - **Dual Brand Storefronts:** Distinct storefronts for *House of Deepak* (Indian ethnic wear) and *Scan by Deepak Raj* (contemporary Western wear).
  - **Product Discovery:** Multi-attribute filtering, high-resolution image galleries, size & color variant selector, stock management.
  - **Shopping Cart & Checkout:** Persistent cart, coupon code engine, dynamic price breakdown.
  - **Payment Gateway:** Razorpay with client modal, secure backend order creation, HMAC signature verification, webhook reconciliation.
  - **User Auth & Accounts:** Email/Password and Google OAuth, password reset, order tracking and history.
  - **Admin Dashboard:** Business analytics, CRUD for products & categories, order lifecycle management, user & coupon management.
  - **Security:** Firestore RBAC, input validation, WCAG AA accessibility, dynamic meta tags, Open Graph, schema.org, GA4 e-commerce tracking.
- **Live Demo Link:** [https://houseofdeepak.in](https://houseofdeepak.in)

### GTA Maharashtra Mods – Digital E-commerce & Asset Delivery Platform
- **Type:** Live Site (E-commerce) / Client Project
- **Client:** Krushna Mali (GTA Maharashtra Mods)
- **Tech Stack:** Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+, Custom Event Bus), Tailwind CSS, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions Node 22, Cloud Storage), Razorpay (UPI, Cards, NetBanking), Swiper.js, GLightbox, AOS
- **Description:** Full-stack e-commerce marketplace and secure digital asset distribution platform built for the Indian gaming community to browse, buy, and download custom 3D GTA V game modifications with INR currency and UPI payment support.
- **Key Features & Modules:**
  - **Zero-Bundle High Performance Frontend:** Framework-free Vanilla JS architecture with custom DOM event bus, achieving sub-second initial loads.
  - **Secure Anti-Piracy Digital Fulfillment:** Zero-trust asset delivery — 3D model ZIPs locked in private Cloud Storage. Cloud Functions verify ownership, enforce a 3-download lifetime limit, and generate 24-hour cryptographic signed URLs.
  - **Razorpay Integration:** UPI, cards, NetBanking; server-side order creation, HMAC-SHA256 verification, webhook reconciliation.
  - **Real-Time Cart & Price Tampering Prevention:** Cart synced to Firestore subcollections with live price hydration to prevent stale discounts.
  - **Live Coupon Engine:** Configurable percentage/flat discounts with expiry, campaign caps, and per-user limits.
  - **Comprehensive Admin CMS:** Mod catalog CRUD, ZIP/media uploads, order tracking, user management, banner announcements, YouTube showcase management.
  - **Multi-Tier RBAC:** Dual-key admin verification, Apache `.htaccess` HTTPS enforcement, Gzip, security headers.
- **Live Demo Link:** [https://gta-maharashtra-mods.vercel.app](https://gta-maharashtra-mods.vercel.app)

### MediScribe AI – Medical Prescription OCR System
- **Type:** AI / Machine Learning Web Application
- **Tech Stack:** Python, PaddleOCR (SVTR_LCNet), PyTorch, OpenCV, spaCy (Medical NER), Flask, Bootstrap, FuzzyWuzzy, FPDF
- **Description:** Advanced AI-powered OCR system specifically designed to interpret and digitize doctors' handwritten medical prescriptions, mitigating medication misinterpretation errors and enhancing patient safety.
- **Key Features:**
  - **Computer Vision Pipeline:** OpenCV adaptive thresholding, Non-Local Means noise reduction, contrast normalization, morphological enhancement.
  - **Handwriting-Optimized OCR:** Multi-pass PaddleOCR with SVTR_LCNet and PyTorch CNN, confidence scoring, GPU acceleration.
  - **Medical Lexicon & Fuzzy Matching:** 60+ Indian pharmaceuticals; FuzzyWuzzy + spaCy Medical NER to extract drug names, dosages, routes, frequencies.
  - **Adaptive Training Mode:** Perceptual hashing (pHash) + Hamming distance to recognize recurring prescription layouts.
  - **Multi-Format Export:** PDF clinical reports (FPDF), CSV logs, JSON for EHR integrations.
  - **Performance:** 95%+ accuracy on trained formats, 90%+ on untrained; 3–5 second average processing latency.
- **GitHub Repository:** [https://github.com/Shriram2005/MediScribe-OCR](https://github.com/Shriram2005/MediScribe-OCR)
